hypotheses.question: Do short causal state motifs combined with a broad clock or movement condition show persistent absolute direction?
hypotheses.stop_condition: No 2025 discovery rule survives unchanged through 2026 Q1 validation with positive lift, payoff, breadth, and twice-cost payoff.

hypotheses.question: Do coarse price-location, displacement, compression, and wick conditions show persistent absolute direction?
hypotheses.stop_condition: Effects reverse, concentrate, or fail unchanged chronological validation.

hypotheses.question: Do compact top-loop summaries add portable direction without using the raw loop-score vector?
hypotheses.stop_condition: Compact loop rules fail validation or add no increment over state/history and price baselines.

hypotheses.question: Does the frozen direction-neutral range permission make directional effects clearer?
hypotheses.stop_condition: Permission does not improve predeclared full-population signatures or atlas economics.

hypotheses.question: Are equal-universe relative winners and losers more predictable than absolute direction?
hypotheses.stop_condition: Track B does not beat contemporaneous relative-strength on unchanged timestamps and cannot support an economic translation.

population.entry: exact provider open at decision ordinal plus one
population.terminal: provider close at decision ordinal plus 24
population.aal_2026_policy: exclude to preserve the already-frozen Long/Short/Neutral V1 source boundary

development_context.role: opened model-fit/development period; never used for atlas rule discovery because structural and movement parameters were fitted on full 2024

chronology.normalisation: discovery-only when a fixed economic scale is unavailable

outcome.primary: fixed next-open to 24th-bar-close terminal economic action value
outcome.long: gross terminal move strictly above +2x round-trip cost and net long payoff positive
outcome.short: gross terminal move strictly below -2x round-trip cost and net short payoff positive
outcome.neutral: neither direction clears the threshold after costs
outcome.unavailable: entry, terminal, complete path, or data quality is missing
outcome.secondary_first_touch: earlier Long/Short/Neutral V1 first touch of the causal per-row barrier_bps = clip(4 * prior_scale_bps, 40, 250); same-bar dual touch remains distinct

movement_permission.model: frozen_loop_movement_shadow_v1 loop_scores future_range_bps h24 point prediction at exact causal state-run entries only
movement_permission.fixed_clock_availability: available only when a frozen causal state run begins on the completed fixed decision bar; otherwise missing and permission fails closed
movement_permission.missing_prediction_state: UNAVAILABLE; never coerced to FAIL or false

feature_rules.structural_loop_and_movement_fields_in_2: UNAVAILABLE; full-2024-fitted parameters were not available at 2024 decisions
feature_rules.loop_summary_availability: exact state-run entries only; arbitrary fixed bars are not silently scored
feature_rules.vti_state_input_boundary: VTI ends 2026-06-26; VTI-dependent state, motif, loop, and movement fields are unavailable for 2026-06-29 fixed-clock rows, which remain in the population
feature_rules.sector_relative_features: unavailable; do not reconstruct from a similar field
feature_rules.quotes_spreads_order_book: unavailable; fixed cost and historical activity proxy only

broad_cap_allocation.univariate_selection: round-robin across feature names and all observed discovery levels

search.tree_role: propose interpretable rules on discovery data only

support.hindsight_episode_concentration: unavailable; no exact outcome-derived episode identity is registered and session-clock cells are not substituted

discovery_score.formula: ((mean_directional_net_bps / 10) + (2 * directional_lift)) * chronological_consistency * breadth_factor * support_factor * cost_survival * neighbourhood_stability - (2 * max(0, top_stock_absolute_contribution_share - 0.25)) - max(0, top_month_absolute_contribution_share - 0.35) - (0.15 * condition_count) - max(0, opposite_direction_rate - unconditional_opposite_direction_rate)
discovery_score.chronological_consistency: fraction of discovery months with positive directional mean net payoff
discovery_score.cost_survival: 1 when twice-cost mean is positive, 0.5 when primary-cost mean alone is positive, else 0
discovery_score.neighbourhood_stability: fraction of available immediately adjacent coarse conditions with compatible positive effect; 1 for non-ordered categorical conditions
discovery_score.ranking_tie_break: higher support, fewer conditions, lexicographically smaller signature_id

multiplicity.broad_discovery_p_value: larger one-sided session-level t-test p-value for directional mean net payoff and directional lift
multiplicity.retained_interval: moving-session-block bootstrap 95% interval with block length five

track_b.benchmark: equal-stock eligible-universe terminal return at identical decision timestamp
track_b.sector_result: not enabled unless exact sector membership and contemporaneous sector returns are available
track_b.execution_gate: run only after a passing independent Track A audit marker exists

secondary_structural_populations.named_loop_candidate: top_parent_loop at the fixed decision, including explicit missing
secondary_structural_populations.control_orientation: top_loop_orientation at the fixed decision, including explicit missing
secondary_structural_populations.loop_family: parent_loop_family at the fixed decision, including explicit missing
secondary_structural_populations.regime_state: current_state at the fixed decision, including explicit missing
secondary_structural_populations.role: predeclared attribution surfaces only; never select a replacement primary population

random_atlas_null.coverage_matching: match discovery and validation directional coverage and discovery long/short mix independently
random_atlas_null.similarity_rule: null validation payoff at or above observed atlas validation payoff in at least 5 percent of draws

prospective_identity.training_data_snapshot_hash: hash of the frozen historical training/source bundle in run metadata
prospective_identity.data_snapshot_hash: hash of the actual immutable causal input snapshot used for that prospective forecast
